name: wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia, get a short summary of an article, get the full article text, or get a random article.

action.description: search: find matching articles. summary: short extract for a known article title. full_article: complete text. random: a random article's summary.

title.description: Exact article title. Required for summary and full_article - get this from a prior search result if unsure of the exact title.

limit.description: Max results for action='search'. Defaults to 5.

max_length.description: Max characters for action='full_article'. Defaults to 5000.
